messages:
maria: Heads up - EU embeddings are experiencing 503 spikes since 23:12 UTC on canary. Need hotfix pinned to image v2026-03-22-embedfix and expedited deploy. Can we opt to skip canary and roll to staging+prod with a short window? @samir @ophelia
jonas: What's the failure mode? rollback criteria? any perf regressions with v2026-03-22-embedfix?
deploy-bot: [check] canary status: failing (avg 503 7.8%). candidate images: v2026-03-22-embedfix (diff: kv-cache tweak). canary tests: backend-health OK, latency +2ms. autoscale check: OK. safe-for-quickroll: false (needs approvals)
ophelia: Logs show a KV cache ttl mismatch on canary. The image fixes the ttl and avoids cache stampede. I ran a quick smoke on staging and only saw 1 minor latency bump.
samir: +1 to expedited roll if we pin to v2026-03-22-embedfix and set canary=0 -> instant pin. Conditions: 1) add release note line, 2) add rollback hook to revert within 15m, 3) notify customer-success for top EU accounts.
release-bot: deploy-checklist: approvals: samir, ophelia. infra-lock: none. scheduled window: immediate. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-rollback
maria: I'll update release_notes and ping CS. Ophelia / Jonas, can you confirm rollback hook exists and metrics alert will trigger at 2x baseline errors?
jonas: rollback hook in place: /ops/rollback embed-service to previous tag. Alert rule updated. I'll watch the first 15m and call rollback if >2x errors.
deploy-bot: action: executor queued -> rolling deploy to dedicated eu-embed pool. pinned image: v2026-03-22-embedfix. canary traffic: 0. start_ts: 1763141592. Expected time: ~3 min.
ophelia: monitoring dashboards set. forwarding to CS. Good luck.
maria: proceeding now. tagging thread as expedited. :rocket:
